# AutoComplete

AutoComplete is a text input that suggests values while typing; unlike Select, any text can be entered. Provide
the suggestions with `options`, usually filtered in `onSearch`.

**Interaction**: filled input like Input. Suggestions open while typing; `↑` / `↓` move the highlight, `Enter`
fills in the highlighted suggestion and `Esc` closes the list without changing the text. Focus stays in the
input.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Email addresses and domains, tags, search with suggestions

## Import

```ts
import { AutoComplete } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Suggests complete email addresses while typing; any text can still be entered.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<{ value: string }[]>([])
  return (
    <AutoComplete
      options={options}
      onSearch={(text) => {
        const name = text.split('@')[0]
        setOptions(name ? domains.map((d) => ({ value: `${name}@${d}` })) : [])
      }}
      placeholder="Email address"
      aria-label="Email address"
      block
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Fixed suggestions

Filter fixed options with `filterOption`.

```tsx
export function Fixed() {
  return (
    <AutoComplete
      options={['Design', 'Development', 'Documentation', 'Delivery'].map((value) => ({ value }))}
      filterOption={(input, option) =>
        String(option?.value ?? '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(input.toLowerCase())
      }
      placeholder="Tag"
      aria-label="Tag"
      block
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | `boolean` | Fills the width of the container, like Select `block`. | — | No |

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`AutoCompleteProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
